messages:
amanda (IC): Hey team — need quick help. My child's primary caregiver changed this week (court-appointed temporary guardianship). Do I need to remove/add dependents or update anything mid-year for medical/dental/FSA? I'm worried about deductions and coverage dates.
liz (People Ops): Sorry to hear that, amanda. Short answer: you can request a midyear change for a qualifying life event (QLE). Temporary guardianship typically qualifies. We'll need the QLE form + legal documentation.
amanda (IC): Thanks. What exact docs do you need? Court order? Affidavit?
ben (Benefits): @liz adding details: we accept either the temporary guardianship court order OR a notarized temporary guardianship affidavit plus proof of residence (utility bill, school record, or medical). If it's time-sensitive, scan and upload first; we can provisionally update pending originals. :+1:
liz (People Ops): Also note plan cutover rules: coverage becomes active the day we process the change (not retroactive unless the QLE date is within the allowed window). Payroll proration depends on the effective date.
amanda (IC): Okay — how long does processing usually take? I need coverage asap for a pediatric appointment next week.
evelyn (People Ops): If you upload docs in Workday and flag it as "urgent QLE", benefits team usually processes within 2 business days. For urgent medical appointments, we can fast-track same-day in exceptional cases — ping me directly with the upload link.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: To submit, use Benefits > Change Election > Qualifying Life Event. Attach supporting docs under "Additional Documentation". See help article: https://redwoodinference.help/qle-upload
amanda (IC): Do I have to change FSA contributions? Childcare FSA enroll/adjust mid-year is confusing — will I lose funds or have to go through payroll changes?
ben (Benefits): Childcare FSA: you can enroll or change election with a QLE. Contributions will be prorated based on effective date. If you already used FSA funds for care earlier in the year, that doesn't disqualify you. We can't change retroactive payroll deductions beyond payroll cutoff dates.
payroll-team: FYI payroll cutoff is noon PT two business days before next pay date. If the effective date is before the next payroll and docs are in before cutoff, we can adjust the deduction for the next pay run.
amanda (IC): Great — will upload now. One more: if the guardianship ends later this year, will I need to re-remove the dependent?
ben (Benefits): Yes — removal is another QLE (loss of dependent). Same doc set applies (court or affidavit). Keep copies of all docs and timeline notes.
liz (People Ops): Quick checklist for you: 1) Scan court order or notarized affidavit 2) Proof of household (utility/school/medical) 3) Submit QLE in Workday and attach docs 4) Mark as urgent if appointment within 7 days 5) Email people-ops@redwood.com with thread link so we can flag processing.
amanda (IC): Thank you!! Uploading now. Really appreciate the fast response :hugging_face:
evelyn (People Ops): Please DM me once uploaded and I'll confirm routing.
people-ops-bot: Submission received (placeholder). Actual status will update when People Ops reviews.
